dispute.claim_text: I told him block 118 clearly in the chat and he said ok coming. Then he went and waited at block 128 which is the next block over, and cancelled on me. Now I have a $4 charge. He replied to my message so he definitely saw it. How is this my fault?

counterparty_statement.text: The pin in my app showed the carpark side and I stopped where the app told me. I waited more than six minutes and nobody came. I should not lose the fee.

admissibility.notes: Cancelled trip record, causally ordered, zone class STANDARD with a single registered pickup point -- which is what forecloses the POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity limb.

dropoff.label: Changi Business Park, 1 Changi Business Park Crescent

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, both tracks present. The driver never comes within 260 m of the Blk 118 pin; the rider sits on it.

issue_details.detail: PII redaction removed the unit number from MSG-00205-001. The block identifier, 'blk 118', survives intact, and that is the operative fact for POL-NS-03(i).

admissibility.notes: The redaction removes nothing the fault allocation turns on. No sequence gap and no hole across the arrival marker, so POL-NS-08(c) is not engaged.
